messages:
jia: FYI I've been watching hosted-usw2: p95 queue wait steadily rising over ~90m, now ~9.8s. Service-side proxy_retries and a handful of 502s. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/hosted-usw2/queue (see spike at 03:10-03:50)
infra-eng: oncall-bot posted alert: hosted-usw2 queue_p95 > 5s (90m) · 6x proxy_retries · top callers: customer-psi-training
oncall-bot: ALERT: hosted-usw2 queue_p95 threshold breached, runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/queue-spike
simon: seeing a handful of long-running training/finetune sessions from customer-psi with large batch sizes. Their jobs are causing KV cache churn -> higher per-request latencies. Also noticed pod churn from preemptible GPUs around same time.
amy: can we confirm eviction rate and cache hit ratio? If it's thrash we could: 1) enable short-term routing to cheaper quantized-cpu model for user-facing low-priority requests, 2) temporarily increase pool size (burst), or 3) tighten admission control for training jobs only.
noah: cost note: spinning up burst GPUs will add ~$X/hr but avoids 503s impacting SLAs. If this recurs we should discuss reserved capacity for heavy trainers.
infra-eng: logs from the proxy (snippet):
```
2026-03-18T03:22:41Z proxy retried request id=abcd status=502 backend_err=kv_miss_stream_timeout
2026-03-18T03:28:12Z admission deny token=0.72 pool=hosted-usw2 reason=slot-unavailable
```
jia: running quick pool snapshot: `redwoodctl pools describe hosted-usw2 --short`
```
capacity: 120 gpus
active: 118 gpus
preemptible_evictions_last_hour: 7
queue_depth: 62
p95_wait: 9.8s
```
simon: that confirms low headroom + evictions. My suggestion: enable a transient +8 GPU burst in usw2 (non-preemptible), and change admission tiering to lower throughput for training-job label `job:trainer` so they don't compete with low-latency API traffic.
amy: agree. I'll flip the admission policy to bias routing: `admission.set-policy --pool=hosted-usw2 --profile=api-first --training-weight=0.3` and roll within 2min. Also enabling the fallback route to `open-quantized-cpu-v1` for requests with low-quality tolerance.
noah: please watch cost for the hour after scale-up and capture token-level cost delta.
infra-eng: scaling now — action: spinning +8 non-preemptible gpus, burst-id = burst-1923. rolling out admission policy change. Will report back in 5m. :rocket:
jia: thanks. once metrics normalize let's run a short post-incident eval and add a pin/limit on ad-hoc customer training jobs. If customer-psi needs sustained capacity we should propose Dedicated capacity (sales flag). /cc @simon @amy
oncall-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: temporary scale +8 gpus started at 1923456810, admission policy rolled at 1923456824. Monitoring p95 and proxy_retries.
